title: I added this door opening animation to my game. Thoughs?
author: W0RKABLE

comments.author: Humble_Junket5884
comments.body:
In my opinion it’s a bit to fast. They look like heavy wooden doors that would open slower. Also when opening them
By hand the movement would not be linear, but slow at first and then accelerating before slowing down again once they are almost open.
Additionally the doors don’t have a thickness. This would become more apparent when slowing the movement down.

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: Good points. I'm a bit worried that if the animation is slowed down then it could also become annoying for some players. I'll tweak the curve a bit more. Thanks!

replies.author: Itchy-Individual3536
replies.body: I share your worries here - yes, a slow animation with a creeking sound effect is cool if you see it just once, but not if you have it for like every time you start the game or a new chapter, level or something. I like the length here, I think it wouldn't annoy me at this length and still adds life and immersion to the UI. But yeah, maybe a tiny bit slower or non-linear is still good. I'd say: if it starts to annoy yourself during playtesting it's too long, if it doesn't, it's fine. You're probably the one seeing this animation the most of all players.

comments.author: wirthmore
comments.body:
The function of a wipe transition is to replace one visual with another. Having an effect for an effect's sake will always make the experience feel slow to the user. In your wipe, the end of the wipe still has a portion of the door and door frame visible, which is not desirable for a wipe, so you perform a second motion to remove them. Preferably, the opening and moving the doorframe out of view should complete in one motion. 

Aesthetically, the 2D motion of the door contradicts the skeumorphic representation. It's clearly a paper-thin object being transformed linearly.

replies.author: W0RKABLE
replies.body: Thanks, you clearly know your stuff, I didn't even know that this is a wipe transition. I made the animation complete in one motion, and it is much better!

comments.author: Thin_Measurement_965
comments.body: Why didn't anything jump out and scream at me?

comments.author: HealthyWest6482
comments.body: Its cool I like it. If i were to add anything just psuedo-3D polish to the frames where the side of the door are facing your pov.
